canonicalRule: 현재 사건 caseTruth.culpritNpcId와 동일한 NPC만 허위 사실을 의도적으로 진술할 수 있다. 무고한 5명은 사소한 이유/사생활/기억 착오를 포함해 사실과 다른 정보를 전달하면 안 된다.

innocent.unknownResponse: 자신이 실제로 알지 못하는 사실은 '모른다/못 봤다'로 구분해서 말한다. 목격했는데 안 봤다고 부정하면 거짓말이므로 불가.

allowConditions: line is authored and approved for the current exact case
statement is permitted by speaker knowledge and prerequisite evidence/previous statement state
if statement.truthStatus == AUTHOR_APPROVED_FALSE then activeNpcId == caseTruth.culpritNpcId AND statement has verified contradictory facts AND refutable evidence route
if activeNpcId != caseTruth.culpritNpcId then every factual claim must be verified true in the current case; truthStatus FALSE or UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE must be rejected
unclear or unobserved information must use a truthful non-assertive preauthored reply
rejects: an innocent NPC making a fabricated, deliberately misleading or mistaken factual claim
using innocent privacy, embarrassment or red-herring status to justify false facts
a contradiction-accepted or retraction-of-false-claim line on an innocent NPC
a contradiction that relies on a wrong quote or facts the speaker could not know
an AI model deciding truthfulness or enabling lying by itself

authoringChecks: All six NPC identities are distinct, and culpritNpcId is one of them.
There are exactly five innocent NPCs and none has a FALSE_CULPRIT_PROPOSED/AUTHOR_APPROVED_FALSE statement.
Every claim given to an innocent must trace to a consistent, knowable event in the validated case.
Every culprit false claim must point to a contradictory verified fact and a discoverable refutation.
CONFRONT_VALID/RETRACT_VALID/MISREMEMBER_VALID involving a false original claim may only target the culprit.
Proof graph, timeline and all physical evidence remain objectively truthful; falsehoods are dialogue only.
No fake contradiction or false rumor may be generated for an innocent to mimic a culprit.
legacyCatalogHandling: Original 228+486 and curated 480 draft lines remain preserved; role-agnostic unverified lines must not be enabled until this policy has been enforced by the game runtime.
